title: Ning Li and Podkletnov rotating superconductors

tellings.quote: But then you got Ming Le's work with the rotating superconductor of IBCO. Also, Eugene Pleutnov used rotating superconductors

plain: Michels says a researcher named Ning Li worked with a spinning disc of a superconducting material, and that another researcher, Eugene Podkletnov, also used rotating superconductors. He brings these up himself, without naming a source, in an episode with a Navy scientist known for patents on UFO-like craft, as earlier work of the same kind on strange physics that might lead to new ways of moving through the air.
